title: BiasMap: Leveraging Cross-Attentions to Discover and Mitigate Hidden Social Biases in Text-to-Image Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the latent concept entanglement between gender tokens and profession tokens using spatial overlap (Intersection over Union/IoU) of cross-attention attribution maps during the diffusion process, alongside evaluating output distribution fairness using Risk Difference (RD) via CLIP-based image classification.
